label: Matched four-account table under determination, by computation
description: A placed diagnostic for 608a262d. Under one determination standard and matched reach and recipient good: necessary manifestation selects only by making c non-contingent; an invariant D-directed source (impersonal propensity, generative finality, or standing will alone) explains 'rather than nothing' and 'rather than the unfit z' but never 'rather than d'; a permissive invariant source does not even explain 'rather than nothing'; every account that selects a contingent c does so through a contingent exercise level that its invariant nature does not see to. Rational adoption, propensity actualization and generative exercise share that encoding, so the standard certifies parity between them: what separates them is the classification and the operative content of the exercise, which this standard does not test. Establishes no premise.
